name: emission-is-not-bounded-by-max-batch
note: max_batch bounds the batches a host delivers to a guest; it does not bound emission. The block ignores its input and emits a fixed batch of four signals while the descriptor publishes a max_batch of two, so a host that also bounded (or truncated) emission by max_batch would refuse the emit or corrupt the batch, and either way fail this scenario. §6.2's three refusals stay the whole list.
